_readme: Site-wide facts used by more than one generator. Change them here, once.
contactEmail    Public address. Appears on every state page CTA and both legal pages.
governingState  State whose law governs the Terms. Should be the state of
incorporation, not whichever state page was built first.
legalUpdated    Date shown on /privacy and /terms. Bump when the text changes.
author          Byline on every blog post. url stays empty until the author page exists.
socials         Footer icons on every page, as [label, icon key in icons.json, url].
